verdict.rationale: Bolt.new is a SaaS AI app-building platform, so offering official SDKs is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack shows no Bolt-published SDK, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Integrations with third-party services (Stripe, Supabase) and the ability to install npm libraries inside projects are adjacent features, not official Bolt SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
